name: quenching-cache
description: Band above the prompt: minutes left on Claude's prompt cache, the next message's estimated cost and one tip, in the repository's declared language. /quenching-cache handoff writes quenching's handoff with Haiku (the expired chat is never resent) and stores it beside its spec through cq; /quenching-cache stats reads cq components session cache. Settings come from shared.cache through cq config; prices are quenching's own table. No network of its own. Derived from cache-maxxing by 5m0k3 (MIT).
